Intro: I want for nothing. Long for nothing. I am at peace. Content with nothing.
Tell me… is it working? Am I saved? Now that I've forsaken all things?
I could know for sure if I ate a [DISH]. One prepared without extravagance. I ask that you serve me honestly.
Success: Then I am free. I can see them again. …Who did I want to see again…?
Fail: You… you prepared this correctly, yes? Then the Spoilage still owns me. What more must I give?
Reject: Has it returned? Was the mere asking for clarity too much? How… how must I live this life?
